articles.title: Love Affair Turns Deadly: Bride Plots Groom's Murder a Day Before Wedding in UP!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Rampur, UP – In a shocking incident, a groom was murdered just a day before his wedding, allegedly by his bride-to-be and her lover. The body of 35-year-old Nihal, a cook by profession, was recovered on Monday from a forested area in Ratanpura, Azimnagar.

body.html:
Rampur, UP – In a shocking incident, a groom was murdered just a day before his wedding, allegedly by his bride-to-be and her lover. The body of 35-year-old Nihal, a cook by profession, was recovered on Monday from a forested area in Ratanpura, Azimnagar.

Nihal had gone missing on June 14 after being lured out by men claiming to be relatives. Police investigation revealed that the murder was planned by Gulfasha, his fiancée, along with her lover Saddam, who was reportedly angry over her marriage.

An FIR for murder and kidnapping has been registered against Gulfasha, Saddam, Farman, and Anees. Saddam and Farman have been arrested, while Gulfasha and Anees are absconding.

ASP Atul Srivastava confirmed that Nihal was strangled and his body dumped in a cornfield. The police say Gulfasha and Saddam had been in a relationship for over a year.

articles.title: Rapido Rider Slaps Woman After Heated Argument Over Rash Driving, Video Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru, June 13 – A Rapido bike taxi rider was caught on camera slapping a woman passenger in Bengaluru’s Jayanagar area after a heated altercation over alleged rash driving and traffic violations.

body.html:
Bengaluru, June 13 – A Rapido bike taxi rider was caught on camera slapping a woman passenger in Bengaluru’s Jayanagar area after a heated altercation over alleged rash driving and traffic violations. The incident has triggered widespread public outrage and renewed concerns over safety in app-based transport services.

The woman, a sales assistant at a jewellery store, was reportedly en route to work when she asked the rider to stop midway due to his reckless behaviour. After getting off, she confronted the rider, identified as Suman S (alias Suhas), which led to a heated argument. A language barrier—the woman spoke English, and the rider only Kannada—further intensified the conflict.

According to CCTV footage and the rider’s statement, the woman allegedly hit him first with her tiffin box. In response, he slapped her, causing her to fall to the ground. Onlookers recorded the video but did not intervene.

The woman initially hesitated to file a formal complaint, but police later registered one and detained the rider for questioning. An NCR (Non-Cognizable Report) has been filed, and police are considering upgrading it to an FIR, pending further investigation.

The incident comes just days before the Karnataka High Court’s ban on bike taxis, amplifying the debate on regulation and safety in the sector. The rider also allegedly used the phrase “Go back to your country”, injecting a communal angle into the controversy.

Rapido has declined to comment, citing the ongoing police probe.

articles.title: Haryanvi Model Sheetal Chaudhary Found Dead in Canal; Family Alleges Murder by Boyfriend
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Sonipat/Panipat – The body of Haryanvi model Sheetal alias Simmi Chaudhary was found in a canal in Kharkhoda, Sonipat, on Monday. She was identified by distinctive tattoos on her hands and chest.

body.html:
Sonipat/Panipat – The body of Haryanvi model Sheetal alias Simmi Chaudhary was found in a canal in Kharkhoda, Sonipat, on Monday. She was identified by distinctive tattoos on her hands and chest. Sheetal had gone missing on June 14, the day she left her Panipat home for a shooting in Ahar village.

Before disappearing, Sheetal had made a distressing video call to her sister Neha, alleging that her boyfriend Sunil, a hotel owner from Karnal, had assaulted her and was trying to forcefully take her away. After that call, her phone went unreachable.

On Sunday, Sunil’s car was recovered from the Delhi Parallel Canal, with him inside. He survived, but Sheetal was missing. Neha then lodged a missing person’s complaint in Panipat’s Urlana Kalan police station.

Neha revealed that Sheetal met Sunil while working at Hotel Sukoon. After learning Sunil was already married with two children, Sheetal broke ties and left the job. However, Sunil allegedly continued to harass her and showed up at her shoot location the night she disappeared.

The Sonipat police have confirmed the identity of the body and are investigating the case. The family strongly suspects murder.

articles.title: “Will Shoot So Many Bullets, Even Family Won’t Recognise You”: Woman Points Gun at CNG Staff
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hardoi (UP): A shocking incident unfolded at a CNG station in Hardoi, where a woman pointed a revolver at a CNG salesman’s chest after being asked to get down from the car for safety during refuelling.

body.html:
Hardoi (UP): A shocking incident unfolded at a CNG station in Hardoi, where a woman pointed a revolver at a CNG salesman’s chest after being asked to get down from the car for safety during refuelling.

An argument broke out, during which the woman threatened the staff saying, “I will shoot so many bullets that even your family won’t recognise you.”

Police have registered an FIR against Ariba Khan, Husnbano, and Ehsan Khan. The revolver has been seized, and a probe is underway.

articles.title: Zip Line Horror in Manali: 12-Year-Old Girl Falls 30 Feet Mid-Ride — Caught on Camera!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Manali: A 12-year-old girl from Nagpur, Trisha Bijwe, was seriously injured after falling from a 30-foot height when a zip line snapped mid-way during her vacation in Manali. The June 8 incident was caught on a phone camera and has now gone viral on social media.

body.html:
Manali: A 12-year-old girl from Nagpur, Trisha Bijwe, was seriously injured after falling from a 30-foot height when a zip line snapped mid-way during her vacation in Manali. The June 8 incident was caught on a phone camera and has now gone viral on social media.

Trisha suffered multiple leg fractures and was initially treated at a private hospital in Manali before being referred to Chandigarh for advanced care. Her father alleged lack of safety measures at the adventure site and claimed they did not receive immediate medical help after the fall.

Trisha has now been discharged and is in stable condition, according to the family.
